channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli strike kills at least five people at wedding in Gaza
item.description: Casualty toll is expected to increase, reports Al Jazeera's Hani Mahmoud.

item.title: Groom killed hours before his wedding in Gaza
item.description: Muhannad Farwana never got to wear his wedding suit, Israel killed him in an air strike hours before his wedding.

item.title: Iran 2026 World Cup squad heads to Mexico as US visa dispute erupts
item.description: Iranian officials say a 'large' number of key staff denied visas as the team is set to travel to Mexico.

item.title: Iran fires missiles at Gulf after US targets Iranian radar sites
item.description: US CENTCOM says ballistic missiles fired towards Kuwait and Bahrain; Iran denounces US attacks as a violation of truce.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
item.description: The US military strikes Iranian drones and radar sites and Tehran says it has targeted US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Lebanon says three soldiers killed in Israeli attack on car
item.description: The Israeli military is investigating the incident in south Lebanon, where it is fighting Hezbollah.

item.title: Iran says staff blocked from entering US after players given World Cup visas
item.description: Iranian officials say technical staff have been denied visas, hours after the US said players could enter the country.

item.title: Palestinian baby killed by Israeli gunfire in West Bank, health ministry says
item.description: The Israeli military says Friday's "incident is under review", expressing "deep sorrow for any harm caused".

item.title: Is there an AI stock market bubble, and is it ready to burst?
item.description: Despite the Iran war, inflation and debt fears, US markets keep hitting record highs, fueled largely by AI. BBC's Samira Hussain looks into whether that bubble will burst.
